description: This source file implements the core communication functions for the AUTOSAR-compliant COM module, including signal transmission, reception, dynamic signal handling, and interaction with the PDU Router. It contains functions for sending and receiving signals and signal groups, trigger transmission, and handling PDU indications, confirmations, and shadow buffer updates.

methods.name: uint8 Com_SendSignal(Com_SignalIdType SignalId,const void * SignalDataPtr)
methods.description: Sends a signal by writing data to the PDU buffer, setting update bits, and potentially triggering a transmission based on transfer property.

methods.name: uint8 Com_ReceiveSignal(Com_SignalIdType SignalId,void * SignalDataPtr)
methods.description: Receives a signal by reading data from the PDU buffer, supporting deferred processing and buffer locking.

methods.name: uint8 Com_ReceiveDynSignal(Com_SignalIdType SignalId,void * SignalDataPtr,uint16 * Length)
methods.description: Receives a dynamic signal by copying data from the PDU buffer, handling variable length signals, with concurrency considerations.

methods.name: uint8 Com_SendDynSignal(Com_SignalIdType SignalId,const void * SignalDataPtr,uint16 Length)
methods.description: Sends a dynamic signal by copying data into the PDU buffer, setting update bits, and possibly triggering transmission.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType Com_TriggerTransmit(PduIdType ComTxPduId,PduInfoType * PduInfoPtr)
methods.description: Provides data for transmission to the PDU Rearchitecture, copying current PDU data to the transmit buffer.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType Com_Internal_TriggerIPduSend(PduIdType ComTxPduId)
methods.description: Explicitly triggers the sending of an IPDU if conditions like minimum delay and callouts are satisfied, coordinating with PDU Router.

methods.name: void Com_TriggerIPduSend(PduIdType ComTxPduId)
methods.description: Wrapper around the internal trigger function, invoked to send IPDU asynchronously.

methods.name: void Com_RxIndication(PduIdType ComRxPduId,const PduInfoType * PduInfoPtr)
methods.description: Handles received PDU indications, including copying data into the IPDU buffer and processing signals.

methods.name: void Com_TpRxIndication(PduIdType PduId,NotifResultType Result)
methods.description: Handles TP layer reception confirmation, unlocking buffers and processing signals.

methods.name: void Com_TpTxConfirmation(PduIdType PduId,NotifResultType Result)
methods.description: Handles TP layer transmission confirmation, currently only unlocking buffers.

methods.name: void Com_TxConfirmation(PduIdType ComTxPduId)
methods.description: Handles confirmation of PDU transmission at the upper layer, placeholder function.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType Com_SendSignalGroup(Com_SignalGroupIdType SignalGroupId)
methods.description: Sends a signal group by copying data from shadow buffer to the PDU buffer, updating update bits, and triggering transmission if needed.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType Com_ReceiveSignalGroup(Com_SignalGroupIdType SignalGroupId)
methods.description: Receives a signal group by copying data from the PDU buffer to the shadow buffer, with buffer locking consideration.

methods.name: void Com_UpdateShadowSignal(Com_SignalIdType SignalId,const void * SignalDataPtr)
methods.description: Updates shadow buffer with new signal data, preparing for potential transmission or further processing.

methods.name: void Com_ReceiveShadowSignal(Com_SignalIdType SignalId,void * SignalDataPtr)
methods.description: Copies signal data from shadow buffer into the signal structure, for further application processing.
